mapper.select: SELECT FROM messaging_deliveries WHERE request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT behavior FROM messaging_faults WHERE request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM messaging_faults WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND behavior='THROTTLE_ONCE'
mapper.update: UPDATE messaging_deliveries SET status=outcome,finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE status='ACCEPTED' AND ready_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY ready_at LIMIT 100
mapper.select: SELECT FROM messaging_deliveries ORDER BY accepted_at DESC,request_id LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
